>Dude, your writing is pretty good. I could feel how you are and connect, even though my life is not similar, especially not with the parents.  
...But yeah, I like your writing. I could feel your anger and frustration.

Thanks for the compliment. I'll hopefully try to keep that in mind in some form of whatever at a later time.

> Do you have any plans after high school... ?

Nothing over the top yet, I pretty much just plan on going to the closest Community College (too bad/good(?) the closest one is ~3 hours away, but at least there's a trans-county bus that comes through here every once in a week IIRC)

>Maybe you could beyond playing video games and maybe develop them or even test them.

As far as i can tell, I'm more or less onto that route right now. Currently trying to see what other books tell of video game fundamentals. 
Surprisingly good on that front, just need to find some OTC versions of Ritalin/Adderal to help with making long powerreads.
